text:
Drake Batherson has 11 goals in 22 games for a Senators team that has won three straight, and the latest one opened Tuesday's 2-1 win in Winnipeg on the power play (Graeme Nichols's reaction was "THE POWER PLAY SCORED"). He ranks 19th of 542 skaters in our wins added, which counts how much each goal moved the chance of winning.

The finishing is running ahead. Eleven goals on 7.5 expected means 22% shooting, and he shot 20% last season, so he's a good finisher, just not quite this good. The process is steady: 1.15 expected goals per 60, a little above last season, and Ottawa takes 54% of the expected goals at five on five with him on.

Last season Evolving-Hockey said his chances deserved more than his goals delivered, so this year may be some of that evening out. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 89th percentile among forwards for primary shot assists, which is why his nine assists look light next to his goals.
